core_memory.diabetes_treatment: Type 2 Diabetes: Currently on metformin 1000 mg twice daily. A1C around 6.9%. Doctor suggested adding semaglutide(Ozempic) at a low dose to improve blood sugar control and appetite management. Fasting blood sugar typically ranges between 125-130 mg/dL.
core_memory.hypertension_treatment: Losartan 50 mg once daily. Blood pressure typically ranges from 135-140/80-90 mmHg. Doctor recommends stress management and reduced sodium intake instead of increasing dosage. Taking a daily magnesium supplement, which may support blood pressure regulation.
core_memory.hypothyroidism_treatment: Levothyroxine 75 mcg once daily, taken on an empty stomach, 30 minutes before eating. Last TSH result: 2.1 mIU/L(within normal range). Doctor has not adjusted dosage in years. Noticeable sluggishness if a dose is missed; uses a pill organizer to stay on track.
core_memory.osteoarthritis_treatment: Acetaminophen as needed for mild pain. Meloxicam 7.5 mg prescribed for flare-ups(knees and hands), taken only when joints are stiff or painful. Avoids daily use to minimize NSAID risks. Doctor suggested glucosamine supplements; effect not yet confirmed.
core_memory.vitamin_d_and_bone_health: Vitamin D3 2,000 IU daily due to low levels(22 ng/mL; normal >30 ng/mL). Taking calcium supplements due to early osteopenia on bone density scan. Doctor recommends combining with vitamin K2 to improve calcium absorption and bone health.
core_memory.cholesterol_management: Atorvastatin 10 mg daily to manage cholesterol. Initial LDL: 130 mg/dL(elevated), triglycerides: 140 mg/dL. Doctor prescribed low-dose statin to improve lipid profile. Cholesterol levels have improved since starting; no reported side effects(e.g., muscle aches).
